text:
olivia: Quick async standup — paste a 1-2 line update (what I did / blockers / today). Focus for this sprint: Search Relevance v2 launch prep, canary on Wed. Flag anything blocking the roadmap or launch checklist.

ben: what I did: merged core scoring change (PR #4123), updated rollout script, ran perf sweep on small shard. blockers: flaky E2E failing on session cookies in staging, still investigating. today: repro & fix E2E, follow up with eng-sre on autoscale policy.

sanjay: what I did: drafted reranker spec and evaluation harness, pushed PR #4130 for review. blockers: need product signoff on relevance thresholds + golden set. today: add eval dashboards and run batch eval with updated thresholds. @olivia can you review spec when you have a sec?

maia: what I did: final UX copy for search results + tooltips, updated Figma (link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz). blockers: none. today: accessibility pass and prepare screenshot assets for release notes.

ben: ping @eng-sre — can we get capacity sign-off for a canary with 5% traffic? Also need a short-lived extra pod for the perf sweep (NVIDIA nodes). :pray:

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary rollout for "search-relevance-v2" queued for 2024-06-25 09:30 UTC. Canary window: 30m, auto-rollback on >1% error or latency regressions.

olivia: prioritization notes: 1) Blockers (E2E, legal privacy checklist) must be cleared before broad rollout. 2) If E2E fix not in by Tue EOD, we do limited canary + monitor only. 3) QA signoff needed by EOD Tue for full rollout Thurs.

sanjay: proposed metrics for go/no-go: p95 latency, top-k relevance delta, CTR on organic queries. Quick query to fetch metric: `/api/metrics?range=24h&metric=p95` — will add dashboard tile. Also suggest regression thresholds: p95 <= baseline + 10% and relevance delta >= +3%.

maia: will do screenshots + short animations for the release note. Can someone confirm copy for the feature banner? Draft: "Improved search relevance with reranking and shorter response times."

ben: FYI I'll be offline 14:00-16:00 PST today (doctor appt). If anything blocks deployment ping @sanjay or @olivia. I'll also drop a small fix for the cookie flake in PR #4126 by EOD. :+1:

olivia: noted. @ben thanks — if PR lands and E2E passes we can widen canary to 20% after the first 30m. Otherwise stick to 5% and manual checks. Please update the launch checklist when you push fixes.

maia: quick question — do we have a customer-facing rollback message ready? I can draft a short line.

olivia: yes please draft it — keep it neutral and non-technical. I can review. Example: "We're rolling back a recent update to improve stability; search should be back to normal shortly."

ben: leaving this here as a code snippet that helped repro the cookie issue in staging, fwiw:
```
# repro script
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/search -d '{"q":"test"}' -H "Cookie: session=abc123"
```

sanjay: I'll add the canary monitors and the alert runbook. If anyone wants to pair on the runbook sync at 17:00 UTC, ping me.

olivia: thanks team — keep updates here. If anything critical comes up DM me. :thumbsup:
